description.en: Prompt-polish button inside the DSH composer (left of the model selector): stream-optimizes the draft via the ported prompt-optimizer template engine (system/user/iterate modes), with copy, write-back, write-back-and-send, variable extraction, consent-gated local history with version chains, three-column version comparison with local structural analysis, and per-run token usage. Nothing leaves the machine.
description.zh: DSH 输入框内的「提示词润色」按钮（模型选择器左侧）：移植 prompt-optimizer 的模板引擎（系统/用户/迭代三模式），流式输出优化稿，支持复制、写回草稿、写回并发送、变量提取；历史采用本机授权制并带版本链，可三列对比与结构分析；每次润色的 token 消耗可见。数据不出本机。
